Big green olives stuffed with blue cheese, crumbed in panko and fried until crunchy, served hot on picks with a lemon and chive mayo. Drain 24 large pitted green olives and pat dry. Push a little blue cheese (80g total) into each. Roll in 40g plain flour, then 1 beaten egg, then 60g panko crumbs. Heat 5cm oil in a saucepan to 180C and fry the olives in two batches for 1 to 2 minutes until golden. Drain on paper towel. Stir the zest of 1 lemon and 1 tbsp chopped chives into 100g mayonnaise. Serve the olives hot on toothpicks with the mayo.

Toasted triple-decker with poached chicken, crisp bacon, avocado, cos and tomato, a lemon mayo through every layer, cut into triangles and pinned. Poach 2 chicken breasts in simmering salted water for 15 minutes, rest 10 minutes and slice. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Toast 12 slices of white sandwich bread. Mix 100g mayo with the juice of half a lemon. For each sandwich, spread 3 slices with mayo and layer chicken, sliced avocado (2 total) and cos on the first, bacon and sliced tomato on the second, and top with the third. Pin with 4 toothpicks and cut into triangles.
W: Puff pastry rounds filled with custard and topped with berries, baked at 200C for 15 minutes and glazed.
K: A sugar cube soaked in bitters at the bottom of a chilled coupe, a splash of brandy, topped with cold champagne and a long twist of lemon. Chill 4 coupes and a bottle of champagne or other dry sparkling wine. Drop a sugar cube into each glass and shake 3 dashes of aromatic bitters over it. Add 15ml brandy to each. Tip the glass and pour the sparkling slowly down the side so it doesn't foam over, about 120ml each. Peel 4 long strips of lemon zest, twist them over the drinks to spray the oil and drop them in.

s.how: Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into squares. Spoon a little sweetened cream cheese and apricot jam into the centre and fold the corners in. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Dust with icing sugar and eat at a shop window.

Boil 8 eggs, halve, mash the yolks with mayonnaise and pipe back, then dust with paprika. Beat cream cheese with chives and fill short celery sticks. Lay both out on silver trays for a crowded apartment party.

m.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thin fries and fry twice until crisp. Sear 4 sirloin steaks and rest. Toast cracked peppercorns in the pan, add 200ml cream and simmer until thick. Serve with fries and a green salad.

w.how: Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into rounds. Spoon custard into the centre of each and top with blueberries. Brush the edges with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Brush with warm apricot jam. Best eaten outside a jewellery shop.
